name: org.agentability/agentability
title: Agentability
description: Check whether AI agents can use any website, live: nine checks and a 0-100 score. Look up the weekly AI-Readiness Index of the web's most-visited sites and its headline findings. Read-only.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Run a live AI-agent readiness check of a public website and return its score and each check.

tools.name: lookup_index
tools.description: Return a site's score, rank and report link from the weekly AI-Readiness Index.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Return the Index's headline numbers, such as how many top sites block AI agents.
